via.name: Roys Peak
via.quote: This strenuous hike begins with the track to Roys Peak (1578 m)

evidence: The track starts at the Roys Peak Track carpark on the Mt Aspiring road, 6 km from the Wanaka township. It ends on the Cardrona Valley Road,10 km from Wānaka township (look for a small carpark next to a deer fence at Spotts Creek).
A poled track from this junction drops down into Spotts Creek then out to the Cardrona Valley Road and carpark.
The Skyline Track can be walked in either direction.

doubts: Page says it can be walked in either direction; recorded as one way (not a separate way).
